Impacted Systems: Any system using the malicious 'stringjs_lib' npm package
Attack Vector: Counterfeit versions of popular npm library 'string'
Indicators of Compromise: Package published from a standalone, pseudonymous npm account 'stringjs_npm'.
The 'index.js' file in the package contains tightly packed code sequence of 233,700+ characters.
The package attempts to make dubious web requests.
The package contains code similar to Discord infostealers, which look for a user's Discord files and tokens and upload this information via hardcoded Discord webhooks.
The package downloads more payload from a specified URL.
